testcase.name: CPM and CPC estimates use cents without an artificial dollar floor
draft reads are account-scoped, bounded and expired drafts are not restored
fixed crop is re-rendered from source at 1.00 while dimensions automatically reach each cap
unsupported WebP encoder PNG fallback is checked by actual bytes and MIME
cancellation aborts before allocating an encoding surface
source headers reject mime mismatch, excessive pixels and files above 100 MB
server and browser share the exact daily schedule contract
campaign list return path retains its query and rejects external or unrelated routes
campaign detail links safely carry the validated list return path
invalid return destinations are not propagated into detail links
only eligible and observed readiness checks are treated as passing
empty or unresolved readiness results never claim that all checks pass
successful checks are counted, while blocking checks take precedence in the summary
missing or unrelated moderation does not invent a review status
pending review rows match the API review category instead of claiming paused or active
approved active and paused campaigns retain their delivery labels
unmatched search produces no rows and no pagination without mutating input
shrinking results clamps a later page to the last available page
numeric column sorting covers the entire result before pagination and toggles direction
changing a column resets pagination and starts ascending
search trims whitespace, ignores case, and resets pagination
